svg.title: AVS Azure landing-zone reference design
svg.desc: Proposed private Azure hub-and-spoke hosting for AVS, with on-premises Citrix connectivity and local application data.
svg.text: Optional Azure hosting for the same Linux product | Private workload | NetScaler ADC & Gateway 14.1 first
Inherited policy, tags and least privilege
AVS OIDC + MFA; conditional on integration
Reuse existing hub services where available.
CORP MANAGEMENT GROUP / AVS WORKLOAD SUBSCRIPTION
rg-avs-prod / spoke VNet / illustrative address plan: 10.40.0.0/24
Private IP only; no VM public IP
Docker Compose: web, API, worker, optional collector and PostgreSQL
Protected local secret files; authenticated and audited approvals
Single host: controlled updates and tested recovery
Hub–spoke peering + gateway transit; explicit routes through Azure Firewall
Blob PE in snet-pe + private DNS
1 Corporate connectivity: users reach AVS privately; collector reads NetScaler management over the hybrid link.
2 Hub–spoke routing: configure peering, gateway transit, NSGs, UDRs and return paths; peering alone is insufficient.
3 Backup: host maintenance uploads a coordinated DB + evidence backup through a Blob private endpoint.
Solid blue = logical connectivity / data flow. Dashed blue = administration. Control-plane services are shown above.
PROPOSED REFERENCE · Addresses are illustrative · Existing platform services assumed · No high-availability claim
